statement: Linux v6.12 treats the Wii U Pro as an internal Pro extension with no external expansion port or MotionPlus and consumes the 21-byte extension-only input report 0x3d via the Wii protocol dispatcher; opening the Pro input node requests extension reporting.

applicability.revision: Wii U Pro; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: Pro module and report dispatch only, not physical reporting cadence.
